parameters.stopping_rule: Use TDPT estimate_relative_iqae, with L>0 and (U-L)/(2L)<=0.01. Each adaptive batch has a fresh binomial draw. Spending alpha_t=0.05/[t(t+1)].
parameters.admission_rule: Use the measured native k=1 pilot time as an initial estimate for one Q. Admit a requested power extension only if its additional Q count times the largest observed seconds/Q times 1.25 fits the remaining 900-second admission window, and available physical memory is at least 768 MiB. Recheck before each iterate. A running iterate may finish after this window.
parameters.error_rule: Sum discarded L2 amplitudes across completed prefix iterates. Require each of the norm residual, nonzero work probability and inconsistent mark probability plus the induced probability bound to be below 2e-11 before drawing counts.
parameters.simulation: Direct sparse evolution through primitive marked-A and Grover gates. Fresh ideal binomial shots for each admitted batch. Cache the highest computed quantum state; use no transport reference or analytic law for sampling.
